text:
nina-sales: Hey team — kickoff for Galile0 Bank POC. They need streaming + function/tool-calls + structured output. Big asks: on-prem connector (VPC), SAML SSO, offline KMS, and a pricing ballpark. Can eng -> presales help assemble a POC checklist and blockers list? :wave:

sam-eng: Yep. Quick q: which SDKs are they planning to run? Rust adapter at edge + Python backend?

nina-sales: Exactly. Rust for the adapter, Python for orchestration. Also they insist on SSE fallback because of corporate proxies.

kevin-ml: For streaming we usually recommend WebSocket for lowest latency and SSE as the proxy-friendly fallback. For toolcalls, we can stream partial function-call JSON (so the client can render incremental results). Example fragment we send over SSE/Ws:

```json
{"type":"tool_call.part","call_id":"c-123","payload":{"name":"get_account","args_partial":"{\"acct_id\":\"...\"}"}}
```

sam-eng: For the Rust SDK: ephemeral creds example (headers) — they should rotate every 5m for on-prem edge adapters behind customer firewall:

```rust
let req = Client::new()
  .post("https://inference.redwood.example/generate")
  .header("Authorization", format!("Bearer {}", ephemeral_token))
  .header("X-Request-ID", request_id);
```

ops-bot: Note: reserved capacity recommended if they expect sustained >500 qps. Burst pricing and per-token costs differ between Hosted vs Dedicated. (See docs /pricing/reserved-capacity) :information_source:

nina-sales: Ballpark pricing ask: customer expects ~200 qps baseline, spiky to 1k qps. Any quick numbers I can put in an email?

sam-eng: Quick high-level: Hosted (pay-as-you-go) might be ~2-3x per-token vs Dedicated at committed throughput. For 200 qps steady: consider a small Dedicated pool (~2-4 GPUs) + burst to hosted. I'll get exact ranges — depends on model size + quantization.

kevin-ml: On the security questionnaire: we support SOC2, SAML SSO, and BYOK/HSM for Private deployments. We can provide pen test summary + contact for ent. security reviews. For offline KMS, we have an on-prem package that integrates with customer HSM via our connector.

maria-se: Structured output guidance: prefer using a top-level schema key so evals/telemetry still parse. Example payload we suggest for tool / function responses:

```json
{
  "response":"...",
  "structured":{
    "tool_calls":[{"name":"get_account","status":"complete","result":{...}}],
    "assertions":[{"id":"acct-check","ok":true}]
  }
}
```

sam-eng: Blockers for scheduling POC: 1) allowlist IPs (we'll give a short list), 2) SAML metadata exchange, 3) temporary KMS test creds or HSM access plan, 4) acceptance test prompt set. If they can't allowlist, we can run via site-to-site VPN or Agent/edge.

nina-sales: Great — can you each drop the specific docs? I need: allowlist IPs, SAML SSO steps, ephemeral token example, reserved-capacity estimator, and the security contact.

kevin-ml: Will do — I'll DM the sec contact and attach SOC2 + pen-test summary.

sam-eng: I'll prep the allowlist + ephemeral token code snippets + a minimal runbook for Rust adapter integration. Targeting share by EOD tomorrow.

maria-se: I'll add the structured-output examples + a small eval prompt set that fails if tool-calls are malformed.

nina-sales: Thanks. I'll pull this into a one-pager for the customer and request SAML metadata. Tentative POC start in 2 weeks if network + SAML ready. :calendar:

ops-bot: Reminder: submit Dedicated trial request form once PO/commit looks likely — lead time for GPUs ~3-4 weeks.

nina-sales: Noted. Thanks all :thumbsup:

[thread end]
